name: handlebars-jle
description: Faster Handlebars templating with JSON Logic Engine

scripts.build: npm run generate:parser && rm -f *.d.ts parser/*.d.ts && tsc index.js --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --allowJs --target esnext --moduleResolution NodeNext --module NodeNext && bun build --minify index.js --outdir=dist/cjs --format cjs --external 'json-logic-engine' --sourcemap=external && echo '{"type": "commonjs"}' > dist/cjs/package.json && bun build --minify index.js --outdir=dist/esm --format esm --external 'json-logic-engine' --sourcemap=external && echo '{"type": "module"}' > dist/esm/package.json
